movie.title: Oldboy
movie.overview: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.

facts: Did you know the movie's title, 'Oldboy', isn't just a random pick? It actually refers to male former pupils of schools in Britain and several Commonwealth countries like Australia, Canada, and New Zealand!
Here's another cool fact about the title: 'Oldboy' can also specifically denote a cadet who has attended St. John's Military School. It's fascinating how much history is packed into that one word!

But beyond its intriguing title, the film itself tells the intense story of a desperate man mysteriously imprisoned, drugged, and tortured for 15 years, only to be released with a burning desire for revenge.
